name: ovoz
description: Talk to Claude Code in Uzbek (or Russian, English, Turkish…) and hear it answer — free, offline-first: SoX mic → whisper.cpp with an Uzbek fine-tuned model → tmux types the text into Claude; OmniVoice reads the answer offline in your own cloned voice (edge-tts as fallback). /ovoz skill + hooks + claude-voice launcher + agent-sky visualizers.
